# Gen17 low-skew factor: overlap diagnostics

- Preregistration: `PREREG_low_skew_factor_gen17_20261107.md`
- Preregistration SHA-256: `ecd75ddbae7b59813bbc4837aba2f58d139adb8ec117c89087d07e7334e6cc58`
- Input manifest SHA-256: `395e3acc608493164700e2fcdfebebe9bca541bfa6e952a3cebdb15ab81a85b4`
- Scope: descriptive, date-by-date cross-sectional Spearman correlation of ascending bias-corrected skew rank (G1) against realized volatility, compounded 63-session return, and maximum signed daily return. This is not a performance test or evidence of an edge.
- OOS calendars: US 962 union sessions / 46 decision dates; KR 934 union sessions / 45 decision dates. Eligible cross-sections were exactly 7 US and 21 KR names at every registered decision.
- Cross-implementation verification: A/B/C produced identical eligible names and all three correlations on all 91 dates; maximum absolute difference was 0.0 for both A–B and A–C.
- Median absolute correlation (date denominator): US volatility 0.267857 (46), compounded return 0.553571 (46), maximum session return 0.678571 (46); KR volatility 0.284416 (45), compounded return 0.190909 (45), maximum session return 0.648052 (45).
- This artifact records only the preregistered overlap diagnostic. It does not authorize or imply a performance conclusion.

Columns: date, eligible names, terminal-skip flag, rho(G1, realized volatility), rho(G1, compounded 63-session return), rho(G1, maximum signed daily return).
